mapper.sql: version.scoped_version_id, version.scope_id, scope.policy_template_id AS template_id, scope.legal_entity_id, template.template_code AS policy_kind, version.version_number, COALESCE(( SELECT CASE event.action WHEN 'VALIDATED' THEN 'VALIDATED' WHEN 'PUBLISHED' THEN 'PUBLISHED' WHEN 'ROLLED_BACK' THEN 'PUBLISHED' ELSE 'DRAFT' END FROM attendance_policy_lifecycle_event event WHERE event.scoped_version_id = version.scoped_version_id AND event.action IN ( 'DRAFT_CREATED', 'VALIDATED', 'PUBLISHED', 'ROLLED_BACK' ) ORDER BY event.event_sequence DESC LIMIT 1 ), 'DRAFT') AS status, version.parameters_json, version.effective_from, version.effective_to, version.change_reason, version.validation_json, version.snapshot_json, version.snapshot_digest, version.rollback_of_scoped_version_id, GREATEST(0, ( SELECT COUNT(*) - 1 FROM attendance_policy_lifecycle_event event WHERE event.scoped_version_id = version.scoped_version_id )) AS row_version, version.created_by, version.created_at, ( SELECT MAX(event.recorded_at) FROM attendance_policy_lifecycle_event event WHERE event.scoped_version_id = version.scoped_version_id AND event.action = 'VALIDATED' ) AS validated_at, ( SELECT MIN(event.recorded_at) FROM attendance_policy_lifecycle_event event WHERE event.scoped_version_id = version.scoped_version_id AND event.action IN ('PUBLISHED', 'ROLLED_BACK') ) AS published_at, ( SELECT MIN(event.business_effective_from) FROM attendance_policy_lifecycle_event event WHERE event.scope_id = version.scope_id AND event.scoped_version_id = version.scoped_version_id AND event.action IN ('DEACTIVATE_SCHEDULED', 'ROLLED_BACK') ) AS deactivation_effective_from

SELECT scope.scope_id, scope.policy_template_id AS template_id, scope.legal_entity_id, template.template_code AS policy_kind, scope.row_version FROM attendance_policy_scope scope JOIN attendance_policy_template template ON template.policy_template_id = scope.policy_template_id WHERE scope.policy_template_id = #{templateId} AND scope.legal_entity_id = #{legalEntityId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM attendance_policy_scoped_version version JOIN attendance_policy_scope scope ON scope.scope_id = version.scope_id JOIN attendance_policy_template template ON template.policy_template_id = scope.policy_template_id WHERE version.scoped_version_id = #{scopedVersionId}

SELECT version.scoped_version_id FROM attendance_policy_scoped_version version WHERE version.scope_id = #{scopeId} AND version.effective_from <= #{businessDate} AND (version.effective_to IS NULL OR version.effective_to > #{businessDate}) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM attendance_policy_lifecycle_event publication WHERE publication.scope_id = version.scope_id AND publication.scoped_version_id = version.scoped_version_id AND publication.action = 'PUBLISHED' AND publication.business_effective_from <= #{businessDate} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM attendance_policy_lifecycle_event later WHERE later.scope_id = publication.scope_id AND later.event_sequence > publication.event_sequence AND later.business_effective_from <= #{businessDate} AND later.action IN ( 'DEACTIVATE_SCHEDULED', 'ROLLED_BACK' ) ) ) ORDER BY version.version_number, version.scoped_version_id
SELECT event.scoped_version_id FROM attendance_policy_lifecycle_event event WHERE event.scope_id = #{scopeId} AND event.action = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY event.event_sequence DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance_policy_scoped_version ( scoped_version_id, scope_id, version_number, parameters_json, effective_from, effective_to, validation_json, snapshot_json, snapshot_digest, rollback_of_scoped_version_id, row_version, change_reason, created_by, created_at ) VALUES ( #{row.scopedVersionId}, #{row.scopeId}, #{row.versionNumber}, #{row.parametersJson}, #{row.effectiveFrom}, #{row.effectiveTo}, #{row.validationJson}, #{row.snapshotJson}, #{row.snapshotDigest}, #{row.rollbackOfScopedVersionId}, #{row.rowVersion}, #{row.changeReason}, #{row.createdBy}, #{row.createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT lifecycle_event_id, event_sequence FROM attendance_policy_lifecycle_event WHERE scope_id = #{scopeId} ORDER BY event_sequence DESC LIMIT 1
